rawContent: I am proud of every woman who came forward, and who didnt, may God give you strength enough. I want you to know that I am always here, if you are afraid, i am here to support you and listen to you. My DMs are open and my eyes and mind too. Talk to me if need be! #TimesUp #Metoo

#MeToo would not have been a massive movement as it is today if it was not for utilizing Twitter as a platform. Just two cents into people saying Twitter is not the right place for opening up on issues like harassment, ill-treatment, abuse etc.
This year, Larry Nassar and Bill Cosby got a verdict and jail time. This is a very crucial moment for women and what #MeToo has helped us all achieve.
